newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Strayed "dumb" Caribbean turtle found in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Strayed "dumb" Caribbean turtle found in Argentina.

text.p: A strayed Caribbean sea turtle that swam 5,000 miles (8,000 km) to the River Plate is now recovering from the ordeal in the Buenos Aires Zoo, Argentine media said on Saturday.
The species, popularly known as "dumb turtle", was spotted on Thursday swimming near a hydroelectric power plant whose turbines were stopped to prevent the turtle from being killed.
The 32 inch (80 cm), 90 pound (43 kilos) turtle was recovering well after having eaten fish at the local zoo.
Experts said marine streams could have swept the turtle away from its natural waters. Authorities said they would wait until it gained 80 pounds (36 kilos) before sending the turtle back out to sea.
